purpose: Half-time analysis; teach 前半/プレー/速度/抵抗/発揮/ワールドカップ/タイム/レース

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: measured fan recapping calmly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: でも惜しいプレーが何度もあった。
lines.en: But there were close plays again and again.
lines.style: animated fan recalling near-misses, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: パスの速度がどんどん上がってる。
lines.en: The pace of the passes keeps rising.
lines.style: observant newcomer noticing the tempo, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相手の抵抗をどう崩すかが鍵だ。
lines.en: Breaking the opponent’s resistance is the key.
lines.style: tactical fan framing the challenge, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 後半、エースが本領を発揮するはず。
lines.en: In the second half, the ace should shine.
lines.style: hopeful fan predicting confidently, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ワールドカップの舞台、緊張するだろうね。
lines.en: The World Cup stage must be nerve-wracking.
lines.style: empathetic newcomer imagining the pressure, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 終盤はタイムとの戦いになる。
lines.en: The endgame becomes a battle against time.
lines.style: fan anticipating the clutch moments, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まるで長距離レースの駆け引きだ。
lines.en: It’s like the tactics of a long-distance race.
lines.style: fan extending the analogy, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
